citations.claim: first violation: controller force 579.9 exceeds fmax 11.34 at step 14
force at step 13 was clamped at limit before explosion
initial speed shows high initial energy allowing high velocity error

counterfactual.change: reduced kp from 12.013 to 0.1 only (fmax unchanged); this lowers kp*velocity_error below fmax so clamp is not needed and violation disappears

explanation: Shrunk scenario has hover controller on body 1 with kp=12.01, fmax=11.35, vcmd=12.43. At step 13 controller force is exactly at limit (11.345) while body speed is ~50.6. At step 14 the body nears/overshoots waypoint (17.35,10.16 vs waypoint 18.1,10.8) with high speed 50.25 and 55 substeps, velocity-error kp*error produces ~579.9, 51x over fmax, indicating the force clamp to fmax is not applied (or is scaled incorrectly with substeps/high kp). Lowering kp to 0.1 with identical scenario eliminates violation (force 4.88 at step 14), proving gain/clamping interaction is causal.
vision_note: Steps 11 to 13 show the large red body moving rapidly toward the green waypoint in the upper right, and at step 14 it arrives directly on/ slightly past the waypoint without decelerating. No wall penetration or exiting the arena is visible; the failure is a high-speed waypoint intercept that would require a very large braking force.
